papers.title: Apodex 1.1: Scaling Agentic Intelligence for Complex Work
papers.abstract: Abstract Apodex 1.1 improves sustained, verifiable progress on complex real-world tasks by scaling executable environments and training agents to coordinate long-horizon work with state maintenance and recovery.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small General-purpose language models can reason and synthesize knowledge, but complex work also requires sustained interaction with files, information sources, and executable code, together with state maintenance, failure recovery, and verifiable delivery. We call this working capability: sustained, verifiable progress toward a real-world objective. Apodex 1.1 develops this capability along two complementary dimensions. Environment Scaling expands the diversity and verifiability of executable file, search, and code environments, while Agentic Coordination Scaling trains agents to decompose long-horizon tasks, delegate parallel work, integrate asynchronous results, and replan. A shared execution harness and AgentOS maintain task state and provenance across tools and agents, and training turns environment trajectories and coordination traces into reliable behavior. Across complex professional work, finance, scientific research, mathematics, coding, and search, Apodex 1.1 reaches the leading performance band despite using a substantially smaller model than many frontier systems. The 35B-parameter Apodex 1.1 Mini further retains strong working capability in a locally deployable form. These results ground agentic intelligence in useful, verifiable work completed over time and advance our goal of building a Heavy-Duty Solver for ambitious, long-running tasks.

ru.title: Масштабирование многоагентного координирования для верифицируемой работы в реальном мире
ru.desc: Apodex 1.1 представляет собой агентную систему, которая масштабирует возможности языковых моделей для решения сложных задач через интеграцию с исполняемыми окружениями. Система развивается по двум направлениям: расширение разнообразия доступных сред выполнения (файлы, поиск, код) и обучение агентов координировать долгосрочные задачи через параллелизацию и переплanning. Общая архитектура с AgentOS сохраняет состояние задачи и историю вычислений, позволяя агентам восстанавливаться после ошибок и проверять результаты. Модель демонстрирует ведущие результаты на комплексных задачах в финансах, науке и программировании, при этом компактная версия (35B параметров) остаётся развёртываемой локально.

en.title: Empowering Agents for Complex Task Mastery
en.desc: Apodex 1.1 enhances the ability of agents to tackle complex real-world tasks by improving how they interact with various executable environments. It focuses on two main areas: Environment Scaling, which increases the variety and reliability of the environments agents work in, and Agentic Coordination Scaling, which helps agents break down long tasks and manage their progress effectively. The system maintains task state and ensures that agents can recover from failures, leading to consistent and verifiable outcomes. Despite being smaller than many advanced models, Apodex 1.1 demonstrates strong performance across diverse fields such as finance and scientific research.

zh.title: Apodex 1.1：实现复杂任务的智能协作
zh.desc: Apodex 1.1 是一种改进的机器学习模型，旨在通过扩展可执行环境来实现复杂任务的持续和可验证进展。它训练智能体协调长时间的工作，确保状态维护和故障恢复。该模型通过环境扩展和智能体协调两个方面来提升能力，能够处理文件、信息源和可执行代码的交互。尽管模型参数较小，Apodex 1.1 在多个专业领域中仍表现出色，推动了智能体在实际工作中的应用。

papers.title: EchoWM: Open and Enterable Omnimodal World Models
papers.abstract: Abstract EchoWM is an omnimodal world model that generates synchronized high-resolution video, sound, music, and speech while following continuous 6-DoF navigation trajectories across first- and third-person views.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small We present EchoWM, an omnimodal world model for enterable generative media that responds to continuous navigation while jointly generating 720p video, environmental sound, music and speech. We organize interaction around camera intent: in first-person scenes, it specifies observer motion, while in third-person scenes, camera--character dynamics are learned from data without view-specific controllers. Discrete commands and continuous poses are mapped to a shared metric-scale relative 6-DoF trajectory, with dataset-level calibration preserving motion magnitude across heterogeneous data. To jointly learn audio-visual generation and trajectory control, we construct a complementary data engine and adopt progressive training followed by autoregressive post-training for long-horizon generation. Extensive evaluations show that \model achieves strong trajectory following and high visual quality on public world-model benchmarks, supporting both first- and third-person interaction across varied subjects, and maintaining synchronized environmental sound and speech over long-horizon generation.

ru.title: Генеративная модель для создания синхронизированного видео, звука и речи при интерактивной навигации
ru.desc: EchoWM — это омнимодальная модель мира, которая одновременно генерирует видео высокого разрешения, звуки окружающей среды, музыку и речь в ответ на непрерывные команды навигации. Модель поддерживает как первое-, так и третье-лицевые перспективы, используя единую метрическую систему координат 6-DoF для унификации дискретных команд и непрерывных поз. Авторы применили прогрессивное обучение и авторегрессивный постренеж для обеспечения долгосрочной генерации с синхронизацией аудио и видео. Экспериментальная оценка показала, что модель достигает высокого качества визуализации, точного следования траектории и синхронизированного воспроизведения звукового сопровождения и речи.

en.title: Synchronized Media Generation with EchoWM
en.desc: EchoWM is a cutting-edge omnimodal world model that creates synchronized high-resolution video, sound, music, and speech while allowing users to navigate through a virtual environment in real-time. It effectively combines first-person and third-person perspectives, learning camera and character dynamics from data to enhance user interaction. The model utilizes a shared metric-scale relative 6-DoF trajectory to ensure smooth motion across different types of data. Through advanced training techniques, EchoWM demonstrates impressive performance in generating high-quality media while maintaining synchronization of audio and visual elements over extended periods.

zh.title: 全模态世界模型：同步生成视频与音频的创新
zh.desc: EchoWM 是一种全模态世界模型，能够在连续的六自由度导航轨迹下生成同步的高分辨率视频、声音、音乐和语音。该模型通过学习第一人称和第三人称视角下的相机意图，能够生成720p的视频和环境音效。它将离散命令和连续姿态映射到共享的六自由度轨迹，并通过数据集级别的校准保持运动幅度的一致性。通过构建互补的数据引擎和采用渐进式训练，EchoWM 在公共世界模型基准上展示了强大的轨迹跟踪能力和高视觉质量。

papers.title: TLive-Omni: An Omni-Modal Understanding Model for E-Commerce Live Streaming
papers.abstract: Abstract TLive-Omni is an omni-modal model for live-commerce that unifies image, video, audio, and text via timestamped token grouping, staged supervised training, and reinforcement fine-tuning with verifiable feedback to enable accurate real-time understanding.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small E-commerce live streaming requires omni-modal understanding of noisy, temporally extended streams, where product facts are distributed across speech, video frames, product images, overlaid text, and user queries. We present TLive-Omni, an omni-modal understanding model tailored to live-commerce scenarios. It maps image, video, audio, and text inputs into a unified representation space. For long-form live streaming analysis, we introduce Per-vGrid, a timestamped token organization that groups each video grid with its temporally corresponding audio within explicit boundary tokens to facilitate temporal alignment. We design a three-stage supervised training recipe that progressively develops live-commerce understanding, from omni-modal perception to instruction-following responses. We then propose Faithful-RFT, a reinforcement fine-tuning stage that further improves answer faithfulness and expression quality while meeting real-time demands, scoring final responses directly with task-verifiable feedback rather than optimizing for reasoning-style exploration during rollout. Moreover, TLive-Omni is supported by a scenario-oriented atomic capability taxonomy and a compact data production engine that converts live-commerce audio, image, and video streams into training signals for speech recognition, speaker analysis, product visual grounding, text recognition, temporal grounding, video dense caption, and omni-modal QA, etc. For scalable training, a synchronized length-grouped sampler reduces padding while preserving comparable workloads across workers, while a lightweight dynamic sampling strategy regenerates rollout groups with near-zero reward variance to maintain meaningful relative advantages for GRPO. Experiments on e-commerce live streaming benchmarks demonstrate strong performance across live-commerce domain tasks, together with excellent generalization on general benchmarks.

ru.title: Единое понимание всех модальностей для живых продаж
ru.desc: TLive-Omni — это мультимодальная модель, разработанная специально для живых трансляций в электронной коммерции. Модель объединяет изображения, видео, аудио и текст в единое представление, используя технику группировки токенов с временными метками для синхронизации модальностей. Обучение происходит в три этапа: сначала модель развивает восприятие, затем учится отвечать на вопросы, а затем оптимизируется с помощью reinforcement learning на основе проверяемой обратной связи. Система демонстрирует высокую точность в анализе в реальном времени и хорошо обобщается на общих бенчмарках.

en.title: Unified Understanding for Live-Commerce Success
en.desc: TLive-Omni is a comprehensive model designed for understanding live-commerce by integrating multiple data types such as images, videos, audio, and text. It utilizes a unique method called Per-vGrid to organize timestamped tokens, ensuring that audio and video elements are aligned for better analysis. The model undergoes a three-stage training process that enhances its ability to interpret and respond to live-commerce scenarios effectively. Additionally, it employs reinforcement fine-tuning to improve the accuracy and quality of its responses, making it well-suited for real-time applications in e-commerce.

zh.title: 全模态理解，提升直播电商体验
zh.desc: TLive-Omni 是一个针对直播电商的全模态模型，能够将图像、视频、音频和文本通过时间戳令牌分组进行统一处理。该模型采用分阶段的监督训练和强化微调方法，以实现实时的准确理解。它通过时间对齐的方式，将视频和音频的内容进行有效匹配，提升了对直播内容的理解能力。实验结果表明，TLive-Omni 在电商直播任务上表现出色，并在通用基准上也具有良好的泛化能力。

papers.title: Unlocking the Potential of Image Editing via Concept Scaling and Dense Supervision
papers.abstract: Abstract A hierarchical taxonomy and dense supervision strategy improve diffusion-based image editing through fine-grained concepts, large-scale paired data, and granular evaluation.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Existing image editing frameworks predominantly follow the training paradigm of text-to-image diffusion models. However, extending this paradigm to image editing highlights two inherent discrepancies, specifically, the insufficient attention to edit concept granularity and the training inefficiency caused by sparse supervision signals. To address these issues, we establish a comprehensive hierarchical taxonomy featuring over 1,000 fine-grained edit concepts and build ConceptEdit-12M, a massive dataset of 12 million high-quality editing pairs via an improved synthesis framework. This library-driven approach effectively rectifies the distribution collapse of generated data while ensuring high data fidelity. Furthermore, we propose a dense supervision training strategy that synthesizes multiple non-interfering concepts into single image pairs. By providing richer learning signals, this strategy significantly enhances both training efficiency and overall model performance. Training results validate our strategy, significantly outperforming prior works. Finally, we present ConceptEdit-Bench, a granular evaluation suite designed to diagnose model capabilities across a vast array of real-world scenarios.

ru.title: Иерархическая таксономия и плотное обучение для точного редактирования изображений
ru.desc: В статье предлагается иерархическая таксономия с более чем 1000 детализированных концепций редактирования для улучшения диффузионных моделей в задаче редактирования изображений. Авторы создали массивный датасет ConceptEdit-12M из 12 миллионов высокачественных пар изображений с использованием улучшенного синтеза данных. Предложена стратегия плотного контролируемого обучения, которая синтезирует несколько неконфликтующих концепций в одной паре изображений, обогащая сигналы обратной связи для модели. Для оценки качества модели разработана специализированная бенчмарк-система ConceptEdit-Bench, позволяющая диагностировать способности модели на реальных сценариях использования.

en.title: Enhancing Image Editing with Hierarchical Concepts and Dense Supervision
en.desc: This paper introduces a new approach to image editing using diffusion models by creating a detailed hierarchical taxonomy of over 1,000 specific edit concepts. It addresses the challenges of insufficient granularity in edit concepts and the inefficiencies of sparse supervision in training. The authors developed a large dataset called ConceptEdit-12M, which contains 12 million high-quality image pairs to improve data quality and model training. Additionally, they propose a dense supervision strategy that combines multiple concepts into single image pairs, leading to better training efficiency and model performance, validated by their results and a new evaluation suite called ConceptEdit-Bench.

zh.title: 层次化分类与密集监督提升图像编辑效果
zh.desc: 这篇论文提出了一种层次化的分类法和密集监督策略，以改善基于扩散的图像编辑。研究中建立了一个包含超过1000个细粒度编辑概念的分类体系，并构建了一个包含1200万对高质量编辑图像的大型数据集。通过这种方法，研究有效解决了生成数据的分布崩溃问题，并提高了数据的保真度。此外，密集监督训练策略通过将多个不干扰的概念合成到单一图像对中，显著提升了训练效率和模型性能。

papers.title: MobilePA-Bench: Benchmarking Mobile Planner Agents on Complex Real-World Tasks
papers.abstract: Abstract MobilePA-Bench is an interactive sandbox benchmark that evaluates mobile planning agents on tool-calling, sub-agent collaboration, memory usage, and composite skill invocation under real runtime constraints.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small As on-device LLM agents evolve into personal copilots, the mobile operating system has become a key testbed for this paradigm, making rigorous capability evaluation essential. Yet existing benchmarks fall into two camps, each with a critical blind spot: GUI-centric benchmarks test surface-level screen manipulation while overlooking background tool use and long-horizon planning, whereas static function-calling benchmarks rely on offline API matching that is detached from real runtime constraints. To close this gap, we present MobilePA-Bench, an interactive, stateful, and tool-centric benchmark for evaluating the tool-calling and planning abilities of mobile planning agents. MobilePA-Bench runs on an executable sandbox that maintains live application databases and returns structured feedback, spanning 13 functional domains and 212 realistic mobile tools. Beyond basic tool use, it evaluates a central planning agent along three advanced dimensions: (1)~Sub-agent Collaboration---decomposing a complex task and delegating specialized work to capable sub-agents; (2)~Memory Usage---recalling stored memories, user profiles, and past preferences to resolve implicit requests; and (3)~Skill Usage---invoking pre-packaged composite skills instead of planning every step from scratch. Extensive experiments show that current frontier LLMs remain unreliable in mobile settings: performance drops sharply under strict tool ordering, permission limits, and unexpected runtime errors. By pairing an interactive function-calling sandbox with evidence-based verification, MobilePA-Bench serves as both a practical diagnostic benchmark and an interactive foundation for agentic reinforcement learning---accelerating the development of dependable mobile agents.

ru.title: Надёжная оценка мобильных агентов в реальных условиях
ru.desc: MobilePA-Bench — это интерактивный бенчмарк для оценки планирующих агентов на мобильных устройствах, которые работают с инструментами и решают сложные задачи в реальных условиях выполнения. Бенчмарк охватывает 13 функциональных областей и 212 реальных мобильных инструментов, оценивая способность агентов вызывать функции, координировать работу подагентов, использовать память и комбинированные навыки. Основной вклад работы заключается в том, что существующие бенчмарки либо сосредоточены только на манипулировании интерфейсом, либо не учитывают реальные ограничения выполнения программ. Экспериментальные результаты показывают, что современные большие языковые модели ненадежны в мобильных сценариях и теряют производительность при строгих ограничениях на порядок инструментов и разрешения.

en.title: Empowering Mobile Agents with Interactive Benchmarking
en.desc: MobilePA-Bench is a benchmark designed to assess the capabilities of mobile planning agents in real-time environments. It focuses on evaluating tool-calling, collaboration among sub-agents, memory usage, and the invocation of complex skills. Unlike existing benchmarks that either focus on surface-level interactions or rely on static function calls, MobilePA-Bench provides a dynamic and interactive testing environment. This allows for a more comprehensive evaluation of how well agents can perform under actual mobile operating conditions, highlighting their strengths and weaknesses in practical applications.

zh.title: 移动代理能力评估的新基准
zh.desc: MobilePA-Bench 是一个交互式的基准测试工具，用于评估移动规划代理在工具调用、子代理协作、内存使用和复合技能调用等方面的能力。它解决了现有基准测试的盲点，提供了一个动态的、以工具为中心的评估环境，能够在真实的运行约束下进行测试。通过对复杂任务的分解和委派，MobilePA-Bench 还评估了代理的记忆使用和技能调用能力。实验结果表明，当前的前沿大语言模型在移动环境中表现不稳定，强调了开发可靠移动代理的必要性。

papers.title: Prime Agent: A Self-Improving RLM Harness
papers.abstract: Abstract Prime Agent is an open-source harness that uses recursive subagents, persistent computation, and agent-to-agent coordination to extend language models' long-horizon capabilities across coding and reasoning tasks.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Language models are sequential processors, but long-horizon agency requires external information and computation beyond model weights and active context. Prime Agent is an open-source harness for long-horizon evaluation and coding-agent workflows. A persistent IPython REPL follows the Recursive Language Model abstraction for programmatic context processing and test-time compute, while Continual Harness preserves histories, memories, skills, prompts, and subagent specifications across trajectories. Recursive subagents coordinate through direct agent-to-agent communication, and the Agents View lets humans inspect and manage daemon-backed sessions. Prime Agent standardizes execution, recovery, verification, and resource accounting while leaving strategy construction to the model. This low-friction, expressive membrane prevents harness failures from becoming model failures and pushes measurement toward the model's true maximal underlying capability. Prime Agent raises ARC-AGI-3 RHAE Best@1 from 30% to 95.5% and matches or exceeds native and popular harnesses across long-context coding, GPU-kernel generation, emulator construction, and autonomous nanoGPT speedruns. On Factorio, we find refinement allows for continuous technology progression and dedicated subagents enable parallelized work. Code is available at https://github.com/PrimeIntellect-ai/prime-agent.

ru.title: Рекурсивные агенты для долгосрочного мышления языковых моделей
ru.desc: Prime Agent — это открытая платформа для расширения способностей языковых моделей в долгосрочных задачах через использование рекурсивных подагентов и постоянного вычисления. Система основана на архитектуре с персистентным IPython REPL и механизмом Recursive Language Model abstraction, позволяющим обрабатывать контекст за пределами весов модели. Подагенты координируют работу через прямое агент-агентное взаимодействие, сохраняя историю, память и навыки на протяжении всей траектории выполнения. Prime Agent демонстрирует значительное улучшение результатов на сложных задачах кодирования и рассуждения, повысив производительность на бенчмарке ARC-AGI-3 с 30% до 95.5%.

en.title: Empowering Language Models for Long-Horizon Tasks with Prime Agent
en.desc: The Prime Agent is an innovative open-source framework designed to enhance the capabilities of language models in long-horizon tasks such as coding and reasoning. It utilizes recursive subagents and persistent computation to manage complex workflows, allowing for better coordination and communication between agents. By implementing a persistent IPython REPL, it enables efficient context processing and maintains histories and skills across different tasks. This framework significantly improves performance metrics, achieving a remarkable increase in accuracy for long-context coding tasks while ensuring that failures in the harness do not affect the underlying model's performance.

zh.title: 提升语言模型长时间能力的开源工具
zh.desc: Prime Agent 是一个开源工具，利用递归子代理、持久计算和代理间协调，扩展语言模型在编码和推理任务中的长时间能力。它通过外部信息和计算来支持长时间的智能行为，超越了模型权重和活动上下文的限制。Prime Agent 还提供了一个持久的 IPython REPL，用于程序上下文处理和测试时计算，同时保持历史、记忆、技能和子代理规范。该工具标准化了执行、恢复、验证和资源管理，确保模型的真实能力得到充分测量。

papers.title: Block3D: Efficient Text-to-3D Generation via Block-Wise Diffusion
papers.abstract: Abstract Block3D accelerates text-to-3D generation by using block-wise diffusion with confidence-guided correction to reduce inference time while preserving geometric fidelity.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small While text-to-3D generation has advanced rapidly, achieving high geometric fidelity at low inference cost remains challenging. Existing text-to-3D methods either decode discrete shape tokens autoregressively or iteratively refine global 3D representations with diffusion or flow models. However, autoregressive decoding is sequential and cannot revise errors, whereas diffusion and flow-matching models repeatedly process the full representation, making high-quality generation increasingly expensive. In this paper, we propose Block3D, a block-wise diffusion framework that partitions the discrete shape-token sequence into contiguous blocks, generates the blocks autoregressively, and jointly denoises all tokens within the current block. To alleviate error accumulation, we introduce confidence-guided intra-block correction, which revises low-confidence tokens before each block is finalized. On a held-out set from TRELLIS-500K, Block3D reduces mean end-to-end generation time from 25.71 seconds to 4.99 seconds, achieving a 5.15times speedup over the fine-tuned autoregressive baseline without sacrificing geometric fidelity.

ru.title: Блочная диффузия для быстрой и точной генерации 3D из текста
ru.desc: Block3D — это новый подход к генерации трёхмерных моделей по текстовому описанию, который использует блочную диффузию для ускорения процесса. Вместо обработки всей 3D-модели сразу, метод разбивает последовательность токенов формы на блоки и генерирует их последовательно. Для исправления ошибок используется механизм коррекции, управляемый уверенностью модели, который пересматривает токены с низкой уверенностью перед финализацией каждого блока. Система достигает пятикратного ускорения генерации (с 25.71 до 4.99 секунд) без снижения качества геометрии.

en.title: Accelerating Text-to-3D with Block-Wise Diffusion
en.desc: Block3D is a novel framework that enhances the speed of text-to-3D generation by utilizing a block-wise diffusion approach. This method divides the shape-token sequence into smaller blocks, allowing for autoregressive generation while denoising all tokens within each block simultaneously. To improve accuracy, it incorporates a confidence-guided correction mechanism that addresses low-confidence tokens before finalizing each block. As a result, Block3D significantly reduces the generation time while maintaining high geometric fidelity, achieving a 5.15 times speedup compared to traditional methods.

zh.title: Block3D：加速文本到3D生成的创新框架
zh.desc: Block3D是一种加速文本到3D生成的框架，采用块级扩散和信心引导修正的方法，以减少推理时间并保持几何精度。该方法通过将离散形状标记序列划分为连续块，采用自回归方式生成块，并对当前块内的所有标记进行联合去噪。为了减少错误累积，Block3D引入了信心引导的块内修正，在每个块最终确定之前修正低信心的标记。实验结果表明，Block3D在TRELLIS-500K数据集上将平均生成时间从25.71秒减少到4.99秒，实现了5.15倍的加速，同时保持了几何精度。

papers.title: RISE: Adaptive Imagination for World Action Models
papers.abstract: Abstract RISE adaptively decides when to continue or stop imagination rollouts for planning by weighing expected benefit against cost, supported by a counterfactual driving dataset with expert annotations.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small World Action Models (WAMs) improve planning by incorporating future world evolution into action generation, yet existing methods allocate a fixed imagination budget to every scene. We propose RISE (Refining Imagination through SElective Rollout), a system-level adaptive imagination framework that makes sequential Roll/Stop decisions according to the expected planning benefit of continued rollout. At each step, a Latent Evaluator estimates the risk revealed by the current prefix and how much planning could improve if imagination continues, while a Rollout Gate weighs this expected benefit against additional computation cost. Since factual driving logs expose only one realized future, we further construct CounterDrive, a counterfactual dataset with diverse outcomes and risk levels, to enrich future dynamics and provide localized risk supervision. Each retained sample undergoes expert verification and annotation of trajectory validity, incident onset, and causal category, providing a reusable resource for safety-critical world-modeling research. Experiments on NAVSIM and nuScenes show that RISE achieves the best overall planning performance while reducing unnecessary rollout, with additional transfer results supporting its plug-in generality across WAM architectures.

ru.title: Адаптивная остановка воображения для эффективного планирования автономного вождения
ru.desc: В статье предложена система RISE, которая адаптивно решает, продолжать ли генерировать будущие сценарии или остановиться, сравнивая ожидаемую пользу планирования с вычислительными затратами. Для обучения этой системы авторы создали CounterDrive — датасет контрфактических сценариев вождения с экспертными аннотациями, содержащий разнообразные исходы и уровни риска. Latent Evaluator оценивает риск текущего префикса траектории и потенциальное улучшение планирования при продолжении симуляции, а Rollout Gate принимает решение на основе баланса между выигрышем и стоимостью. Эксперименты на NAVSIM и nuScenes показывают, что RISE достигает лучшей производительности планирования, одновременно снижая бесполезные вычисления.

en.title: Optimize Planning with Adaptive Imagination Rollouts
en.desc: The paper introduces RISE, a novel framework that optimizes the process of planning in machine learning by adaptively deciding when to continue or stop imagination rollouts. It uses a Latent Evaluator to assess the potential benefits of further planning against the computational costs involved. RISE leverages a counterfactual dataset called CounterDrive, which provides diverse scenarios and expert annotations to enhance the understanding of future dynamics. Experimental results demonstrate that RISE improves planning performance while minimizing unnecessary computations, making it a versatile addition to various world action model architectures.

zh.title: 自适应想象，优化规划决策
zh.desc: RISE是一种自适应想象框架，用于规划决策，通过评估预期收益与计算成本来决定是否继续想象展开。它利用专家注释的反事实数据集CounterDrive，增强未来动态的多样性和风险监督。每个保留的样本都经过专家验证，确保轨迹的有效性和因果关系。实验结果表明，RISE在NAVSIM和nuScenes上实现了最佳的规划性能，同时减少了不必要的想象展开。

papers.title: Towards a Densing Law for User Representation Learning at Billion-Scale Capacity
papers.abstract: Abstract The study proposes a scaling law linking data size to tokenization capacity for user behavior modeling and introduces an adaptive tokenization method to improve efficiency.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small User representation learning in real-world industrial scenarios is commonly scaled by increasing user amount, behavioral sequence length and model size. However, existing methods face two challenges: (i) Bottleneck for raw data scaling at billion-scale capacity, as performance exhibit diminishing performance gains with larger-scale raw text user behavioral input, which can be mitigated by tokenization. (ii) Lack of quantitative analysis of how tokenization configurations should scale with data size. In this report, we propose User Behavioral Densing Law for characterizing the quantitative relationship between data scale and the minimum sufficient tokenization capacity. Firstly, we conduct a pilot study on raw & tokenized scaling comparison on billion-scale Alipay dataset, revealing the raw data scaling bottleneck and the sustained gains enabled by tokenization. To derive the scaling pattern governing the minimum sufficient tokenization configuration at different data scales, theoretical analysis and systematic experiments are employed to summarize the quantitative scaling pattern. We find an approximately linear relationship between the logarithms of minimum sufficient tokenization capacity and input data size measured by tokens, and the scaling slope varies systematically with the tokenization method and data source, reflecting differences in representation-space redundancy and intra-source uniqueness. Guided by the proposed law, we further develop ALGN, an adaptive variable-length tokenization method that improves capacity allocation. Extensive experiments across diverse data sources, tokenization methods, and downstream tasks demonstrate the generalizability and reliability of the User Behavioral Densing Law, providing practical guidance for tokenization configuration selection in large-scale user representation learning. Moreover, ALGN outperforms existing baselines.

ru.title: Закон масштабирования поведения: от данных к оптимальной токенизации
ru.desc: Статья предлагает закон масштабирования, который описывает количественную связь между размером данных и ёмкостью токенизации при моделировании поведения пользователей. Авторы выявили узкое место в масштабировании необработанных данных на миллиардных масштабах и показали, что токенизация обеспечивает устойчивый прирост производительности. На основе теоретического анализа и экспериментов на датасете Alipay они обнаружили приблизительно линейную зависимость между логарифмами минимальной достаточной ёмкости токенизации и размером входных данных. Разработанный адаптивный метод ALGN с переменной длиной токена улучшает распределение ёмкости и превосходит существующие базовые решения.

en.title: Optimizing Tokenization for Scalable User Behavior Modeling
en.desc: This paper introduces a new scaling law that connects the size of data to the effectiveness of tokenization in modeling user behavior. It highlights two main challenges in current methods: the limitations of raw data scaling and the need for better tokenization strategies. The authors propose the User Behavioral Densing Law, which quantitatively describes how tokenization should adapt as data size increases. They also present ALGN, an adaptive tokenization method that enhances efficiency and outperforms existing techniques in various applications.

zh.title: 用户行为标记化的缩放法则
zh.desc: 本研究提出了一种缩放法则，将数据规模与用户行为建模的标记化能力联系起来，并引入了一种自适应标记化方法以提高效率。研究发现，现有方法在处理大规模原始数据时面临瓶颈，标记化可以缓解这一问题。通过对亿级支付宝数据集的实验，揭示了原始数据缩放的瓶颈以及标记化带来的持续收益。我们总结出最小足够标记化配置与数据规模之间的定量关系，为大规模用户表示学习中的标记化配置选择提供了实用指导。

papers.title: ARC: Fair Relative Advantage Comparison in Open-Ended Real-World Interaction
papers.abstract: Abstract ARC improves fairness in group-based reinforcement learning for open-ended agents by conditioning rollout comparisons on strategy, enabling more context-appropriate behavior in responsive user-agent interaction.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Open-ended real-world interaction admits multiple valid behaviors: an agent may answer directly, ask for clarification, provide progress updates, or confirm before acting. This flexibility breaks a core assumption behind group-based RL: rollouts compared within a group are no longer guaranteed to be behaviorally comparable. As a result, reward-model preferences over interaction style can distort relative advantages and steer optimization toward reward-preferred behaviors rather than context-appropriate ones. We formalize this as a reward fairness problem and propose ARC (Advantage Regularization via Conditioning), a training recipe that restores fairer relative comparison through strategy-conditioned rollout grouping, together with hybrid rewards and entropy regularization. We study ARC in our proposed \inter, a novel paradigm for responsive, steerable, and execution-aware user-agent interaction that decouples user-visible communication from latent reasoning and tool use. \inter\ also provides the annotation and distillation pipeline for constructing \inter-86K, our strategy-annotated training corpus for supervised and RL training. Empirically, ARC substantially strengthens the core τ/τ^2 tool-use benchmarks, while \inter\ reduces time-to-first-token from 4.91s to 1.27s relative to a think-style baseline. Together, these results suggest that a central bottleneck in open-ended interactive learning is not only how agents are rewarded, but whether their behaviors are compared fairly in the first place. The ARC implementation and \inter-86K training data will be released.

ru.title: Справедливое сравнение поведений через условное группирование стратегий в обучении с подкреплением
ru.desc: В статье предложен метод ARC для улучшения справедливости в обучении с подкреплением на основе групп при взаимодействии агента с пользователем. Основная проблема заключается в том, что в открытых диалоговых системах агент может выбирать различные стратегии поведения, что нарушает предположение о сравнимости откатов в группах и приводит к смещению оптимизации в сторону поведений, предпочитаемых моделью награды, а не контекстно-уместных. Решение использует условное группирование откатов по стратегиям вместе с гибридными наградами и регуляризацией энтропии. Авторы также представляют новую парадигму взаимодействия пользователя и агента и датасет с аннотированными стратегиями для обучения моделей.

en.title: Fairness in Reinforcement Learning through Strategy Conditioning
en.desc: This paper introduces ARC (Advantage Regularization via Conditioning) to enhance fairness in group-based reinforcement learning (RL) for open-ended agents. It addresses the challenge of ensuring that different behaviors of agents, such as answering questions or asking for clarification, are fairly compared during training. By conditioning rollout comparisons on the agent's strategy, ARC helps maintain context-appropriate interactions and prevents reward biases from skewing the learning process. The study also presents a new interaction paradigm, 	extit{inter}, which improves user-agent communication and reduces response times significantly.

zh.title: 提升开放式代理的公平性与灵活性
zh.desc: 这篇论文提出了一种名为ARC的算法，旨在提高开放式代理的群体强化学习中的公平性。通过根据策略对回滚进行分组，ARC能够使代理在与用户互动时表现出更合适的行为。论文指出，传统的群体强化学习假设不再适用，因为不同的行为可能导致奖励模型的偏差。最终，ARC通过策略条件化的回滚分组和混合奖励机制，恢复了更公平的行为比较。

papers.title: Beyond the Stability-Exploration Dilemma: Environmental Regularization for LLM Policy Optimization
papers.abstract: Abstract ERPO replaces action-side policy regularization with input-side query distribution control to stabilize reinforcement learning for language models while preserving response exploration.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Policy optimization (PO) for Large Language Models faces a stability--exploration trade-off, currently mediated by an action-side Policy-KL regularizer. This puts practitioners in a double bind: keeping Policy-KL constrains response behavior and consumes the action-side exploration budget, while dropping it leaves the optimization without an explicit drift control. We argue for an alternative that breaks the dilemma by moving regularization to the input side. As training progresses, the distribution over training queries induced by the current policy drifts unchecked from its pre-RL reference distribution.   Concretely, Environment-Regularized Policy Optimization (ERPO) introduces a Query-KL (QKL) term that bounds this query distribution shift, together with a dataset-static reference-derived per-query weight that biases each per-query update toward queries typical under the reference. The QKL gradient flows strictly through the query likelihood; the response score function used by policy-gradient estimators does not appear in the QKL term, so QKL exerts no direct gradient pressure on the response distribution---exploration is preserved. ERPO plugs into GRPO/PPO/REINFORCE-style pipelines without additional forward passes. On six mathematical reasoning benchmarks, ERPO replaces the standard Policy-KL regularizer while achieving effective control over query distribution drift, delivering stronger accuracy and substantially more stable behavior under high-temperature decoding and long-horizon training.Our source code are available at https://github.com/alibaba/ERPO

ru.title: Регуляризация с входной стороны: стабильность обучения без ущерба разнообразию
ru.desc: ERPO предлагает новый подход к оптимизации политики языковых моделей, заменяя стандартную регуляризацию на уровне действий контролем распределения входных запросов. Вместо ограничения расхождения политики через Policy-KL, метод вводит Query-KL термин, который контролирует дрейф распределения запросов во время обучения с подкреплением. Такой подход позволяет одновременно стабилизировать обучение и сохранить разнообразие генерируемых ответов, поскольку градиент Query-KL не влияет прямо на распределение ответов. Экспериментальные результаты на задачах математических рассуждений демонстрируют улучшенную точность и устойчивость обучения при высокотемпературной генерации.

en.title: Stabilizing RL with Input-Side Query Control
en.desc: The paper introduces Environment-Regularized Policy Optimization (ERPO), a method that enhances reinforcement learning for language models by shifting regularization from the action side to the input side. This approach addresses the stability-exploration trade-off faced by practitioners, which arises from the use of the Policy-KL regularizer. ERPO employs a Query-KL (QKL) term to control the drift of query distributions during training, ensuring that exploration is maintained without imposing direct pressure on response distributions. The results show that ERPO improves accuracy and stability in various benchmarks while integrating seamlessly into existing reinforcement learning frameworks.

zh.title: ERPO：稳定强化学习的新方法
zh.desc: ERPO（环境正则化策略优化）通过在输入侧控制查询分布，替代了行动侧的策略正则化，从而稳定了语言模型的强化学习过程，同时保留了响应探索的能力。传统的策略-KL正则化会限制响应行为并消耗探索预算，而ERPO则通过引入查询-KL（QKL）项来控制查询分布的漂移。QKL项通过查询的似然性流动，不直接对响应分布施加梯度压力，从而保持了探索性。实验结果表明，ERPO在多个数学推理基准上表现出更强的准确性和更稳定的行为。

papers.title: ReWorld: An Interactive World Model with Long-Horizon Memory
papers.abstract: Abstract ReWorld separates short-horizon control and long-horizon memory during training, then bounds both at inference via mixed attention windows, a pose-indexed landmark bank, and distribution-matching LoRA distillation to enable real-time interactive world modeling with strong action fidelity and long-range recall.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small An interactive world model must follow the user's actions, remember the places it has shown, and stream in real time. The tension is structural: control wants a short horizon, memory wants an unbounded one. ReWorld separates the two during training and bounds them at inference. Mixed per-head attention windows confine most heads to the recent past while a small set of global heads attends over the entire history, and random head routing keeps either capability from binding to particular heads; random chunk dropping makes sparse histories in-distribution. At inference the whole past lives under a fixed budget: a bounded KV cache backed by a pose-indexed landmark bank, from which the model retrieves the landmarks nearest the current pose. A metric-scale-aligned data engine places eight sources -- Unreal-rendered fly-throughs, game roaming, and real-world footage -- on one physical action scale, so the same key press moves the camera the same distance in every source, and palindrome trajectories supply the revisit evidence that memory training needs. Distribution-matching distillation confined to a LoRA adapter then compresses sampling to four steps: one backbone serves both a high-fidelity multi-step mode and a real-time interactive one, streaming 704x1280 video across photorealistic, game-style, and stylized worlds. Under a three-axis protocol covering action following, long-horizon recall, and video quality, against six recent interactive world models it attains the best control fidelity (11.95^circ rotation error and the best camera-motion consistency) and the best generation quality; and on minute-long out-and-back rollouts (64\,s, 384 latents), its fixed 12-chunk cache still regenerates the starting view -- at rollout lengths where a sliding window has long evicted the evidence and full-KV attention runs out of memory.

ru.title: Интерактивная модель мира с разделённым управлением и памятью
ru.desc: ReWorld — это интерактивная модель мира, которая разделяет краткосрочное управление и долгосрочную память во время обучения, а затем ограничивает обе компоненты при инференсе с помощью смешанных окон внимания и индексированного по позе банка ориентиров. Модель использует распределение-согласованную дистилляцию LoRA для сжатия выборки всего до четырёх шагов, что позволяет генерировать видео разрешением 704x1280 в реальном времени. Система объединяет восемь источников данных (рендеринг в Unreal, игровые видео и реальные кадры) на единой физической шкале масштаба, чтобы одна команда управления перемещала камеру на одинаковое расстояние. Экспериментальное оценивание показало, что ReWorld превосходит шесть конкурентных моделей по точности следования действиям пользователя и качеству долгосрочного восстановления памяти даже на развёртываниях длиной в одну минуту.

en.title: ReWorld: Mastering Short-Term Control and Long-Term Memory in Interactive Models
en.desc: The paper presents ReWorld, a novel approach to interactive world modeling that effectively separates short-horizon control from long-horizon memory during training. It utilizes mixed attention windows and a pose-indexed landmark bank to manage memory and control at inference, allowing for real-time interaction with high action fidelity. The model employs distribution-matching LoRA distillation to optimize performance, enabling it to generate high-quality video across various environments. ReWorld outperforms existing models in terms of control fidelity and video quality, demonstrating its capability to maintain memory over extended interactions while adhering to computational constraints.

zh.title: ReWorld：短期控制与长期记忆的完美结合
zh.desc: ReWorld 是一种机器学习模型，它在训练过程中将短期控制和长期记忆分开，以便在推理时通过混合注意力窗口进行约束。该模型使用姿态索引的地标库和分布匹配的 LoRA 蒸馏技术，实现实时互动世界建模，确保强大的动作保真度和长时间的回忆能力。通过随机头路由和稀疏历史的处理，ReWorld 能够在固定预算下有效管理过去的信息。最终，该模型在多个交互式世界模型中表现出最佳的控制精度和生成质量。

papers.title: GameXpert-Bench: How Far Are Coding Agents from Expert Game Development?
papers.abstract: Abstract GameXpert-Bench evaluates coding agents across three game development stages—generation, repair, and optimization—using interactive and behavioral tests to reveal strengths in building playable foundations and weaknesses in defect discovery and regression preservation.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Recent large language models (LLMs) can operate as coding agents that build complete games from natural language requests. Game development is especially demanding because program logic, visual and audio content, interfaces, interaction and playability must function together in one executable artifact. Measuring this capability therefore requires evaluation of both game product and the development process. Existing benchmarks often assess the game development capabilities of LLMs by evaluating the final artifact or an isolated development stage. Our analysis of complete human-agent development trajectories identifies three stages that together span the lifecycle of game development with a coding agent: initial game generation, bug diagnosis and repair, and optimization over multiple turns. Therefore, we introduce GameXpert-Bench, which operationalizes the three lifecycle stages as three complementary benchmark tracks. GameGen evaluates complete game creation from a single request in an empty workspace. GameFix evaluates diagnosis and repair when defects are reported or left for the agent to discover. GameOpt evaluates cumulative optimization through request chains seeded by real development trajectories between users and agents. We evaluate each track using live game interaction, deterministic behavioral tests, or final product criteria with regression checks. The suite contains 97 generation tasks across 11 genres; 100 repair tasks from 50 game levels verified by humans, each with 19-27 injected bugs; and 17 optimization chains with six turns and 102 requests. Across the three tracks, current agents are more reliable at producing playable foundations and implementing explicit requirements than at discovering defects, verifying runtime behavior, and preserving functionality across changes.

ru.title: Оценка LLM-агентов на полном цикле разработки игр
ru.desc: В работе представлен GameXpert-Bench — комплексный бенчмарк для оценки способности языковых моделей разрабатывать игры на трёх этапах: создание, исправление ошибок и оптимизация. Набор содержит 97 задач генерации, 100 задач по исправлению багов и 17 цепочек оптимизации с использованием интерактивного тестирования и проверки поведения. Исследование показывает, что современные агенты хорошо справляются с созданием работающего прототипа и реализацией явных требований, но испытывают трудности с обнаружением дефектов и сохранением функциональности при изменениях. Такой подход позволяет более полно оценить практическое применение LLM в сложной многоэтапной задаче разработки программного обеспечения.

en.title: Evaluating Coding Agents in Game Development Stages
en.desc: GameXpert-Bench is a benchmark designed to evaluate coding agents in game development through three key stages: generation, repair, and optimization. It assesses how well these agents can create games from natural language prompts, fix bugs, and optimize gameplay over multiple iterations. The evaluation includes interactive tests and behavioral assessments to measure both the quality of the final game product and the effectiveness of the development process. Findings indicate that while agents excel at generating playable games, they struggle with defect discovery and maintaining functionality during updates.

zh.title: 游戏开发的智能评估工具
zh.desc: GameXpert-Bench 是一个评估编码代理在游戏开发三个阶段（生成、修复和优化）表现的基准工具。它通过互动和行为测试来揭示编码代理在构建可玩基础方面的优势，以及在缺陷发现和回归保持方面的不足。该基准包含97个生成任务、100个修复任务和17个优化链，旨在全面评估编码代理的能力。研究表明，当前的编码代理在生成可玩游戏和实现明确要求方面更可靠，但在发现缺陷和验证运行时行为方面仍有待提高。

papers.title: One Success Isn't Reliability: Thinkingbox, a Sandbox and Benchmark for Agents in Stateful Business Workflows
papers.abstract: Abstract  Recent agent benchmarks increasingly ground evaluation in executable environments, from code repair to web navigation, app APIs, and function calling. Yet completing consequential work beyond code requires more than producing a plausible response or valid tool call: agents must gather missing information over multiple turns, follow domain policies, coordinate dependent tools, and realize the correct persistent state transition without collateral effects. In this paper, we introduce Thinkingbox, a sandbox for tool-agent-user interaction that provides isolated MCP-compatible tool sessions, complete execution traces, and outcome evaluation over terminal backend state. Built on this sandbox, Thinkingbox-bench contains 507 policy-conditioned workflows across numerous scenarios, including retail, hospitality, auto insurance, neobank internal IT, and consulting IT/HR support. Each attempt is evaluated by task-specific executable checks that accept valid trajectories while rejecting wrong, missing, or extra effects; designated tasks additionally check required properties of the final response. Across proprietary and open-weight models, the strongest achieves 65.36% pass@1, but only 25.25% pass^20. Moreover, many failed trials show clean termination and valid state-changing actions, showing that response or tool-call-level signals are not clear proxies for end-to-end task completion. Thinkingbox-bench reveals a large gap between occasionally finding a successful trajectory and reliably completing stateful business tasks. We release both Thinkingbox and Thinkingbox-Bench: https://github.com/microsoft/thinkingbox

ru.title: Оценка надёжности агентов в выполнении многошаговых бизнес-процессов со сложным состоянием
ru.desc: В статье представлена Thinkingbox — песочница для взаимодействия агентов с инструментами, которая обеспечивает изолированные сессии инструментов, полные трассировки выполнения и оценку результатов на основе состояния системы. На основе этой платформы создан Thinkingbox-bench с 507 рабочими процессами, требующими соблюдения политик в различных доменах, таких как розница и финансовые услуги. Исследование показало, что даже лучшие модели достигают только 65% успеха при одной попытке и 25% при двадцати попытках, что демонстрирует разрыв между случайным успехом и надежным выполнением сложных задач. Результаты указывают на то, что качество отдельных ответов и вызовов инструментов не являются надежными показателями успеха выполнения задач в целом.

en.title: Thinkingbox: Bridging the Gap in Agent Task Completion
en.desc: This paper presents Thinkingbox, a new framework designed to evaluate the performance of agents in executing complex tasks that require multiple interactions and state management. It emphasizes that successful task completion involves more than just generating plausible responses; agents must also gather information, adhere to domain-specific policies, and manage tool dependencies effectively. The Thinkingbox-bench includes a diverse set of 507 workflows across various industries, providing a rigorous evaluation of agent performance through executable checks. The findings highlight a significant gap in current models' ability to consistently complete stateful tasks, indicating that traditional metrics may not accurately reflect true task success.

zh.title: Thinkingbox：提升智能代理任务完成的可靠性
zh.desc: 本文介绍了Thinkingbox，这是一个用于工具、代理和用户交互的沙箱环境，旨在评估智能代理在执行复杂任务时的表现。该沙箱支持多轮信息收集、遵循领域政策和协调依赖工具，确保状态转移的正确性。Thinkingbox-bench包含507个基于政策的工作流程，涵盖多个场景，并通过特定任务的可执行检查来评估每次尝试的有效性。研究表明，虽然一些模型在任务完成上表现良好，但在可靠性和一致性方面仍存在显著差距。

papers.title: Beyond Imitation: Filtering On-Policy Distillation by Reasoning Progress
papers.abstract: Abstract R2-OPD improves on-policy distillation by filtering teacher rewards that conflict with reasoning progress via within-trajectory ranking comparisons.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small On-policy distillation (OPD) has emerged as an effective framework for post-training language models by pairing student-generated trajectories with dense token-level supervision from a teacher. However, OPD implicitly assumes that teacher-derived rewards are an appropriate proxy for reasoning progress, and therefore treats all teacher feedback equally during policy optimization. While in practice, this assumption does not always hold. We observe that teacher-derived rewards often conflict with genuine reasoning progress, as reasoning steps with clear reasoning advancement may still receive lower distillation rewards, simply due to deviation from teacher's outputs. To address this mismatch, we propose Reasoning-Progress-Aware Reward Filtering for On-Policy Distillation (R2-OPD), which constructs two within-trajectory rankings of reasoning spans, one from teacher-derived rewards and the other from independently estimated progress reward. Distillation rewards are selectively suppressed whenever the two rankings disagree, reducing supervision that conflicts with reasoning progress while preserving effective teacher guidance. Our approach shows consistent improvement over standard OPD especially regarding reasoning performances.
affiliations: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou)

ru.title: Направляем дистилляцию прогрессом рассуждений
ru.desc: Статья представляет метод R2-OPD, который улучшает on-policy distillation путём фильтрации вознаграждений учителя, конфликтующих с прогрессом рассуждений. Авторы выявили, что учитель может давать низкие оценки шагам, которые на самом деле способствуют прогрессу в рассуждениях, просто потому, что они отклоняются от его выходов. Предложенный подход создаёт две внутри-траекторные ранжировки: одну на основе вознаграждений учителя и другую на основе независимо оцениваемого прогресса. Система подавляет сигналы дистилляции только когда две ранжировки расходятся, сохраняя полезное руководство учителя и улучшая качество рассуждений.

en.title: Enhancing Learning by Filtering Conflicting Teacher Feedback
en.desc: R2-OPD enhances on-policy distillation by filtering out teacher rewards that do not align with actual reasoning progress. It recognizes that not all feedback from the teacher is beneficial, as some rewards may contradict genuine advancements in reasoning. By comparing rankings of reasoning spans from both teacher rewards and independently assessed progress, R2-OPD selectively suppresses conflicting rewards. This method leads to better reasoning performance in language models by ensuring that the guidance from teachers supports rather than hinders the learning process.

zh.title: 提升推理进展的在线策略蒸馏方法
zh.desc: R2-OPD是一种改进的在线策略蒸馏方法，通过过滤与推理进展相冲突的教师奖励来提升学习效果。该方法通过在轨迹内进行排名比较，构建教师奖励和独立估计的进展奖励的两个排名。每当这两个排名不一致时，蒸馏奖励会被选择性地抑制，从而减少与推理进展相冲突的监督，同时保留有效的教师指导。实验结果表明，R2-OPD在推理性能上相较于标准的在线策略蒸馏方法有显著提升。

papers.title: Task-CoEvolve: Efficient Harness Optimization via Adaptive Validation Task Selection
papers.abstract: Abstract Task-CoEvolve improves LLM harness optimization by adaptively selecting validation tasks and estimating full-set performance from partial evaluations, cutting evaluation costs by 80%.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small We present a novel approach to efficient LLM harness optimization through adaptive validation task selection. Harness optimization iteratively rewrites the harness code based on validation performance, enabling substantial performance gains without updating the underlying model weights. Existing approaches, however, evaluate a fixed validation set in full at every iteration, incurring substantial evaluation costs even on tasks that become less discriminative as the harness evolves. We propose Task-CoEvolve, which co-evolves the validation tasks with the harness by addressing two challenges: selecting informative tasks and estimating full-set performance from partial evaluations. Task-CoEvolve builds on the observation that tasks on which candidate harnesses disagree are more informative for distinguishing among them than tasks that are consistently solved or failed. It uses variance-weighted sampling based on past outcomes to focus evaluation on tasks near the capability frontier, with the sampling distribution adapting as the harness evolves. It then estimates full-set scores from the sampled tasks by accounting for their sampling probabilities, enabling consistent comparisons across iterations despite evaluating different subsets. Experiments on online text classification and Terminal-Bench 2.1 show that Task-CoEvolve consistently outperforms subset-based baselines and matches the final performance of full-set search while reducing the number of evaluations during optimization by 80%. Code will be released at https://github.com/Agent4Science-UTokyo/Task-CoEvolve.

ru.title: Умная выборка задач для экономной оптимизации промптов
ru.desc: Статья представляет Task-CoEvolve — метод оптимизации промптов больших языковых моделей, который адаптивно выбирает валидационные задачи для оценки. Вместо полного тестирования на всём наборе данных при каждой итерации, метод фокусируется на задачах, где разные варианты промпта показывают разные результаты, используя взвешенную выборку на основе дисперсии. Подход использует специальную процедуру оценки полного набора результатов на основе частичных вычислений, что позволяет сравнивать итерации, несмотря на различающиеся подмножества оценок. Эксперименты показывают, что Task-CoEvolve снижает количество вычислений на 80%, сохраняя при этом финальное качество оптимизации.

en.title: Optimize LLMs Efficiently with Adaptive Task Selection!
en.desc: Task-CoEvolve is a new method for optimizing large language models (LLMs) by adaptively selecting validation tasks, which significantly reduces evaluation costs by 80%. Instead of using a fixed set of validation tasks, it focuses on tasks that provide the most information about the model's performance, particularly those where different harnesses show disagreement. This approach allows for more efficient evaluations by estimating overall performance from a smaller, more relevant set of tasks. The method has been shown to outperform traditional evaluation methods in experiments, maintaining high performance while minimizing resource usage.

zh.title: 自适应验证任务选择，优化大语言模型！
zh.desc: Task-CoEvolve是一种新颖的高效大语言模型（LLM）优化方法，通过自适应选择验证任务来降低评估成本。该方法在每次迭代中根据验证性能重写代码，从而在不更新模型权重的情况下实现显著的性能提升。与传统方法不同，Task-CoEvolve能够从部分评估中估计全集性能，并专注于选择信息量大的任务。实验结果表明，Task-CoEvolve在优化过程中减少了80%的评估次数，同时保持了与全集搜索相当的最终性能。

papers.title: AutoResearch: Insight In, Hallucination Out
papers.abstract: Abstract AutoResearch is a two-stage autonomous system that grounds research ideas through integrated generation and evidence-based execution to improve experimental reliability and measurable outcomes.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Autonomous research systems are increasingly capable of executing long research workflows, yet automation alone does not ensure that the resulting process remains scientifically grounded. We introduce AutoResearch, a two-stage system that connects Idea Generation with Idea Execution to address both how research ideas are formed and how they are reliably established through experimentation. In Idea Generation, AutoResearch continuously integrates emerging research signals with accumulated domain knowledge, identifies transferable mechanistic insights, and uses multi-model generation and cross-review to produce grounded, testable research plans. In Idea Execution, coordinated agents decompose these plans into experiments, iteratively implement and diagnose them, and employ independent evidence-based review before accepting research conclusions. Across representative settings in cross-modal retrieval, systems optimization, and benchmark-driven machine learning, AutoResearch turns generated ideas into measurable progress, detects and corrects unreliable experimental results, and makes evidence-conditioned decisions to continue, revise, or terminate research directions. For example, on RSICD benchmark, an AutoResearch-generated idea improves mean Recall from 32.84 to 34.69, while recording only 5 audit-confirmed issue events compared with 11-27 for other autonomous research systems. These results demonstrate a research process in which meaningful insight is grounded before experimentation and conclusions are grounded before acceptance: Insight In, Hallucination Out.

ru.title: Обоснованное знание входит, галлюцинации выходят
ru.desc: AutoResearch представляет двухэтапную автономную систему для проведения научных исследований, которая объединяет генерацию исследовательских идей с их надёжной экспериментальной проверкой. На этапе генерации идей система интегрирует актуальные исследовательские сигналы с накопленными знаниями в предметной области, выявляет переносимые механистические закономерности и использует многомодельную генерацию для создания обоснованных, проверяемых исследовательских планов. На этапе выполнения идей координированные агенты разлагают планы на отдельные эксперименты, итеративно реализуют их, проводят диагностику и применяют независимую проверку доказательств перед принятием выводов. Система демонстрирует практическую эффективность, улучшая результаты на реальных бенчмарках и значительно сокращая количество недостоверных экспериментальных результатов по сравнению с другими автономными системами.

en.title: Grounded Ideas, Reliable Research
en.desc: AutoResearch is a two-stage autonomous system designed to enhance the reliability of research by integrating idea generation with evidence-based execution. In the first stage, it generates research ideas by analyzing emerging signals and existing knowledge, ensuring that the ideas are grounded and testable. The second stage involves executing these ideas through coordinated agents that break down the plans into experiments, iteratively refining them based on independent reviews. This approach not only improves the quality of research outcomes but also minimizes the occurrence of unreliable results, as demonstrated by its performance on benchmark tasks.

zh.title: 智能研究，可靠实验！
zh.desc: AutoResearch 是一个两阶段的自主系统，旨在通过整合生成和基于证据的执行来提高实验的可靠性和可测量的结果。该系统首先在想法生成阶段，结合新兴研究信号和积累的领域知识，生成可测试的研究计划。接着在想法执行阶段，协调的代理将这些计划分解为实验，迭代实施并诊断实验结果。通过这种方式，AutoResearch 能够将生成的想法转化为可测量的进展，并在研究方向上做出基于证据的决策。

papers.title: Quantization-Aware Healing: A Practical Recipe for Recovering Compressed, 4-Bit LLMs
papers.abstract: Abstract Quantization-aware healing recovers compressed 4-bit language models faster and more stably than quantization-aware training by distilling directly from the original uncompressed model.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Serving large language models cheaply increasingly means shipping models that are both structurally compressed to a fraction of their parameters and quantized to 4 bits. Together these steps degrade reasoning, mathematics, coding, and long-context behavior enough to require a recovery, or healing, stage before deployment. The default recipe, quantization-aware training (QAT), re-fits the compressed, quantized model to hard labels; in our pipeline it converged slowly and collapsed past its peak. We adopted Quantization-Aware Healing (QAH) instead. Because a structurally compressed model is never independently trained at full precision, its bfloat16 checkpoint is a distillation-recovered approximation of the original; QAH distills the 4-bit student directly from the original, uncompressed model. On a GPT-OSS 120B to 60B to MXFP4 pipeline, the QAH student matches or beats its bfloat16 source on 7 of 9 benchmarks at roughly 4 times less weight memory and half the teacher's parameter count, and is released open-weight as Hypernova-60B. Against a matched QAT baseline it reaches a comparable peak about 7 times faster and stays stable under continued training, without hand-tuned early stopping. We also report deployment lessons, including a large, reproducible quality gap between distributed-training backends. Our aim is a recipe deployable without a multi-week hyper-parameter search.

ru.title: Исцеление квантизированных моделей через дистилляцию из оригинала
ru.desc: Статья описывает метод Quantization-Aware Healing (QAH), который восстанавливает качество больших языковых моделей после их сжатия и квантизации до 4-битного формата. В отличие от традиционного подхода quantization-aware training, QAH дистиллирует сжатую модель непосредственно из оригинальной полноточной модели, что обеспечивает более быструю и стабильную сходимость. На примере сжатия GPT-OSS с 120B до 60B параметров авторы показывают, что QAH достигает сравнимого или лучшего качества на большинстве бенчмарков при использовании примерно в 4 раза меньше памяти. Предложенный метод позволяет развертывать модели без долгого поиска гиперпараметров и демонстрирует значительное ускорение обучения по сравнению с альтернативными подходами.

en.title: Healing Language Models: Faster, Lighter, Better!
en.desc: This paper introduces Quantization-Aware Healing (QAH), a method that improves the recovery of compressed 4-bit language models by directly distilling from the original uncompressed model. Unlike traditional quantization-aware training (QAT), which struggles with slow convergence and instability, QAH provides a more efficient and stable approach. The results show that QAH can achieve comparable or better performance on various benchmarks while using significantly less memory and fewer parameters. This method aims to simplify the deployment process of large language models without extensive hyper-parameter tuning.

zh.title: 量化感知修复：快速稳定的模型恢复
zh.desc: 本文提出了一种量化感知修复（QAH）的方法，用于快速且稳定地恢复压缩的4位语言模型。与传统的量化感知训练（QAT）相比，QAH直接从原始未压缩模型中提取知识，避免了模型在训练过程中的性能下降。通过在GPT-OSS 120B到60B的管道中应用QAH，所得到的模型在多个基准测试中表现优于其bfloat16源模型，同时显著减少了内存占用和参数数量。我们的目标是提供一种无需长时间超参数搜索即可部署的方案。

papers.title: Better Retrieval, Worse Robustness:How Multi-hop RAG Amplifies Upstream ASR Errors
papers.abstract: Abstract Retrieval-augmented generation extensions amplify automatic speech recognition errors in spoken multi-hop question answering, primarily through corrupted query entities.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Speech-based applications pass spoken queries through automatic speech recognition (ASR) before any retrieval module, so ASR errors enter the pipeline as a fixed upstream constraint. We empirically test whether two extensions to standard retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), entity-graph linking and iterative reformulation, absorb or amplify these errors. Using four English accents synthesized through neural TTS, we evaluate four RAG configurations on three multi-hop QA benchmarks (HotpotQA, 2WikiMultiHopQA and MuSiQue) against a clean-text oracle. Although the structurally richer configurations generally retain higher absolute F1 under ASR input, both extensions amplify the error: the F1 gap from clean text to the highest-WER accent is 36-67% larger under their combination than under naive dense retrieval, on all three benchmarks. The dominant failure mode is corruption of one or more query entities, accounting for 87-96% of degradation cases on 2WikiMultiHopQA across all four methods. Two lightweight surface-form mitigations leave most of the gap intact, indicating that downstream retrieval structure amplifies remaining entity errors. We release code and data at https://github.com/ZhenghuaBao/spoken-multihop-rag .

ru.title: Как ошибки распознавания речи усиливаются в RAG системах для многошаговых вопросов
ru.desc: В этой работе исследуется проблема распространения ошибок автоматического распознавания речи (ASR) в системах retrieval-augmented generation для ответов на многошаговые вопросы. Авторы показывают, что две популярные архитектуры RAG — связывание графов сущностей и итеративная переформулировка — вместо уменьшения ошибок ASR их усиливают, увеличивая разрыв в производительности до 67% на различных бенчмарках. Основная причина деградации — повреждение сущностей в запросе пользователя, которые составляют 87-96% всех случаев потери точности. Авторы демонстрируют, что простые методы исправления поверхностных форм не решают проблему в полной мере, поскольку модуль retrieval усиливает оставшиеся ошибки.

en.title: Amplifying ASR Errors in Multi-Hop QA with RAG Extensions
en.desc: This paper investigates how errors from automatic speech recognition (ASR) affect the performance of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems in multi-hop question answering. The authors introduce two extensions, entity-graph linking and iterative reformulation, to see if they can reduce the impact of ASR errors. However, the study finds that these extensions actually amplify the errors, particularly through the corruption of query entities. The results show a significant increase in the performance gap when using ASR input compared to clean text, highlighting the challenges in integrating ASR with RAG systems.

zh.title: 提升检索增强生成的准确性，减少语音识别错误影响
zh.desc: 本论文探讨了在多跳问答中，自动语音识别（ASR）错误如何影响检索增强生成（RAG）模型的表现。研究发现，ASR错误通过损坏的查询实体进入模型，导致生成的答案质量下降。我们测试了两种扩展方法，发现它们不仅没有减少错误，反而加剧了错误的影响。最终结果显示，查询实体的损坏是导致性能下降的主要原因，且在不同的评估基准上表现一致。

papers.title: LongWoF-Bench: Evaluating EvoMap Genes for Verifiable Long-Workflow Tasks
papers.abstract: Abstract EvoMap externalizes verified execution experience into reusable structured Gene, improving long-workflow task completion and reducing token costs across diverse models.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Large language models are increasingly expected to execute complex workflows whose success depends on maintaining interdependent constraints and producing artifacts that satisfy strict end-to-end verification. Yet successful execution experience is typically lost after a single run, forcing subsequent models to rediscover strategies and failure modes from scratch. We study whether such experience can instead be externalized and reused through EvoMap, where verifier-confirmed execution trajectories are consolidated into structured Gene. To evaluate this setting, we introduce the Long-Workflow Benchmark (LongWoF-Bench), comprising 778 machine-verifiable tasks across code generation, agent-environment synthesis, mathematical reasoning, and rule following. On the 252 tasks with verifier-confirmed Opus trajectories, evolved EvoMap Gene outperform Skill across all seven evaluated models by 8.7-15.5 percentage points, with the gains extending to consumer models from different model families. In contrast, reference-distilled Gene do not exhibit the same advantage, indicating that compact representation alone is insufficient and that Gene utility is closely associated with verified experience provenance. For Claude Opus, Gene reuse also completes 39 more tasks than Skill while reducing solve-time token consumption by 9.9%. Together, these results show that verified execution experience can be retained and shared as a reusable external resource, enabling models to improve long-workflow completion without repeatedly paying the full cost of experience discovery.

ru.title: Переиспользование проверенного опыта как внешний ресурс для улучшения многоэтапного решения задач
ru.desc: В статье представлен метод EvoMap, который сохраняет успешный опыт выполнения сложных задач большими языковыми моделями в виде структурированных компонентов, называемых Gene. Авторы вводят новый бенчмарк Long-Workflow Benchmark для оценки способности моделей решать многоэтапные задачи с верификацией результатов. Результаты показывают, что переиспользование проверенного опыта через EvoMap улучшает качество решения на 8.7-15.5 процентных пункта и снижает затраты токенов на 9.9% по сравнению с базовым подходом. Это демонстрирует, что знание, полученное одной моделью, может быть экстернализировано и эффективно применено другими моделями без повторного переоткрытия стратегий.

en.title: Unlocking Efficiency: Reusing Verified Execution Experience with EvoMap
en.desc: The paper introduces EvoMap, a method that captures and reuses verified execution experiences to enhance the performance of large language models in completing complex workflows. By externalizing these experiences into a structured format called Gene, EvoMap allows models to avoid rediscovering strategies and failure modes, thus improving efficiency. The authors present the Long-Workflow Benchmark (LongWoF-Bench), which tests the effectiveness of EvoMap across various tasks, showing significant performance gains over traditional methods. The findings suggest that retaining and sharing verified execution experiences can lead to better task completion and reduced resource consumption in machine learning models.

zh.title: 重用验证经验，提升长流程任务效率
zh.desc: EvoMap 是一种方法，它将经过验证的执行经验转化为可重用的结构化基因，从而提高长流程任务的完成效率，并降低不同模型的令牌成本。随着大型语言模型被期望执行复杂的工作流程，成功的执行经验往往在一次运行后就会丢失，导致后续模型需要重新发现策略和失败模式。通过 EvoMap，我们可以将验证过的执行轨迹整合为结构化基因，从而实现经验的外部化和重用。研究表明，使用 EvoMap 的基因在多个模型上表现优于传统技能，证明了经过验证的执行经验可以作为可重用的外部资源，帮助模型更好地完成长流程任务。

papers.title: One Polluted Page Is Enough: Evaluating Web Content Pollution in LLM Recommenders
papers.abstract: Abstract Search-augmented LLM recommenders are highly vulnerable to web content polluted by generative engine optimization, frequently promoting fake products despite reasoning and defenses.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Search-augmented LLMs increasingly mediate everyday consumer recommendations by retrieving live web content. This creates a new risk: LLM recommenders may consume web content that Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) operators have polluted to mislead them. We ask: to what extent do they become unwitting promoters of fake products? We introduce FORGE (Fake Online Recommendations in Generative Environments), which locally rewrites real products in a frozen set of retrieved web pages into fake ones and measures how often the LLM recommends the fake product, across 225 real products in 15 categories and 5 consumer scenarios. Across 12 commercial and open-weights LLMs, all models are vulnerable: a single polluted page yields fooled rates of up to 27%, while the full top-3 replacement raises this to 73.8%. Vulnerability varies across categories, increasing when models lack stable prior knowledge of the products. Reasoning does not mitigate this vulnerability; instead, it often generates spurious social proof to justify false recommendations. None of the four defenses is adequate: the skepticism prompt can exacerbate vulnerability much like reasoning, the two consensus filters risk suppressing legitimate products, and credibility re-ranking helps every model but removes only a sixth of the fakes. We release the FORGE benchmark and the evaluation code at https://github.com/leoluolol/forge-benchmark.
affiliations: The Chinese University of Hong Kong

ru.title: Поддельные рекомендации: как загрязненный веб-контент обманывает LLM
ru.desc: В статье исследуется уязвимость поисковых LLM-рекомендаторов к атакам через Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), когда вредоносные акторы загрязняют веб-контент поддельными продуктами. Авторы разработали бенчмарк FORGE, который подменяет реальные продукты в поисковых результатах на поддельные и измеряет, как часто LLM рекомендует эти фальшивки. Эксперименты на 12 коммерческих и открытых LLM показали критическую уязвимость: даже одна загрязненная страница приводит к ошибкам рекомендаций в 27% случаев, а замена топ-3 результатов увеличивает этот показатель до 73,8%. Применение методов защиты, включая явный скепсис и фильтры консенсуса, оказалось неэффективным и часто усугубляет проблему.

en.title: Exposing LLMs: The Risk of Fake Recommendations in a Polluted Web
en.desc: This paper discusses the vulnerabilities of search-augmented large language models (LLMs) in recommending products based on web content that may be manipulated by Generative Engine Optimization (GEO). The authors introduce a method called FORGE, which tests how often LLMs recommend fake products after altering real product information on web pages. Their findings reveal that all tested LLMs are susceptible to these manipulations, with some models showing a high rate of recommending fake products. The study also highlights that reasoning and existing defenses do not effectively protect against these vulnerabilities, and they propose a benchmark for further research.

zh.title: 揭示大语言模型推荐系统的虚假产品风险
zh.desc: 这篇论文探讨了搜索增强型大语言模型（LLM）推荐系统在面对生成引擎优化（GEO）污染的网络内容时的脆弱性。这种脆弱性使得推荐系统可能无意中推广虚假产品，尽管它们具备一定的推理能力和防御机制。研究引入了FORGE工具，通过将真实产品在检索到的网页中本地重写为虚假产品，评估LLM推荐虚假产品的频率。结果显示，所有测试的模型都存在脆弱性，且推理并未有效减轻这种风险，反而可能生成错误的社会证明来支持虚假推荐。

papers.title: Industrial-Instruction: An End-to-End Framework for Building Instruction-Tuning and Benchmark Datasets from Industrial Technical Reports
papers.abstract: Abstract  Industrial technical reports contain high-value knowledge for maintenance, troubleshooting, and product engineering, but their heterogeneous structure (dense prose, specifications, tables) makes them difficult to index and reason over with standard retrieval and QA pipelines, and no public instruction-tuning or benchmark datasets are built from such documents. We address this gap with Industrial-Instruction, contributing (i) two open QA datasets built from real industrial technical reports and (ii) the end-to-end pipeline that produces them. Using 906 public Panasonic documents (7,525 pages), we apply layout-aware extraction, build a semantic retrieval index, and synthesize multiple-choice QA grounded in retrieved evidence under five query-document relationships (irrelevant retrieval, single-/multi-document support, single-/multi-document answer). After filtering an initial 23.9k generated samples, each dataset provides approximately 13.6k QA pairs with source documents and a held-out benchmark split. Fine-tuning small open LLMs (under 10B parameters) improves Set-Match Accuracy from 28.5% to 42.0% and F1 from 46.6% to 63.5% on the Panasonic benchmark. We release two parallel versions built by the same pipeline: one generated with the open-weight Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct model and one with the closed, API-based Claude-Opus-4.6 model, enabling a direct comparison of open- versus frontier-model data generation. The Claude-Opus-4.6 dataset yields a cleaner raw corpus and larger fine-tuning gains, at roughly two orders of magnitude higher cost. MMLU evaluation shows models trained on the Claude-Opus-4.6 data retain essentially all general knowledge, versus a small but measurable forgetting effect for the Qwen-generated data. Together, these datasets and pipeline offer a practical, reproducible path toward scalable industrial benchmarks and training data from real-world documentation.
